Its name derives from the deep river chasm that was carved by [[Riven Earth falls|the mighty waterfall]] in the southeast, and continuing its course towards the northwest. The [[Maguuma Jungle]] lies further to the north, separated by mountain ranges and dense forests that have not yet been explored. A variety of creatures can be found here, with the various species of [[Dinosaur]]s prowling the southern half (including a den of [[Raptor]]s), and large [[spider]]s making their nests in the southwest and the cliffs to the north. [[Simian]]s are also found in abundant numbers along the mountain trails and to the north. The [[Asura]] have set up the [[golem]] foundry just northeast of [[Rata Sum]], and they also have a camp in southwest. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== This area is to the east of [[Rata Sum]]. To get here for the first time, start from [[Vlox's Falls]] and head west across [[Arbor Bay]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Sky Krewe Member]]s → [[Asuran influences, it has been reported to range from 260 to 299. ** These [[Quest]]s influence the spawns in this area: [[The Asura Trap]], [[The Cipher of Dwayna]] ** Keep spread out when engaging dinosaurs (especially Ceratadons); their area damage can easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen. ** Keep away from the forested area west of the [[Golem Foundry]], to avoid triggering the hidden North storyline, the small number of [[Destroyer]]s in the north are actually separated into two hostile groups that will fight each other. * This area comprises approximately 6% of the mappable area in Eye of the North; you can uncover most of it during the [[G.O.L.E.M.]] mission by killing the originally spawning Destroyers and before activating the kilns. == Trivia == * The name ''Riven Earth'' is an anagram for ''Thrive Near'' (other locations in the [[Tarnished Coast]] are also anagrams, e.g. ''Rata Sum'' = ''Mursaat''). * There is a big stone bridge spanning the chasm, which can be traversed to quickly get from one side to the other side over the middle of the map. It is however not visible on the minimap. * Near the center, towards the north, there is a circle of 8 [[Venomweaver]]s that surround a [[Ceratadon]] corpse that perform a repeated animation sequence. {{Explorable areas in the Tarnished Coast}} [[de:Zerrissene Erde]]
